title: Using Transformers for Teaching and Learning via Symbolic Distillation of Neural A-life Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks controlling behavior of A-life agents can evolve over multiple generations. While effective in making the agents survive, such networks are generally opaque to a human observer. Furthermore, the neural weights cannot be transferred between agents with different neural architectures. Distilling such neural networks into compact symbolic policies can help humans understand agent behavior in A-life. Additionally, it allows the agents to share their knowledge in a compact fashion, improving population-level learning. Distilling a neural policy into a symbolic policy is typically performed by searching the space of symbolic policies to find one that approximates the neural policy. However, even with a domain-specific language the space of policies can be large, necessitating incomplete stochastic search such as genetic algorithms. translated_title: 使用Transformer通过神经人工生命智能体的符号蒸馏实现教与学
translated_abstract: 控制人工生命智能体行为的神经网络可以在多代中不断演化。虽然这些网络在使智能体得以生存方面非常有效，但对人类观察者来说通常是不透明的。此外，神经权重无法在不同神经架构的智能体之间进行转移。将此类神经网络蒸馏为紧凑的符号策略，可以帮助人类理解人工生命中智能体的行为。此外，这还使智能体能够以紧凑的方式共享知识，从而改善种群层面的学习。将神经策略蒸馏为符号策略通常是通过在符号策略空间中搜索，找到一个能够近似神经策略的符号策略。然而，即使使用领域特定语言，策略空间仍然可能非常庞大，因此需要采用不完全的随机搜索方法（如遗传算法），而且蒸馏过程仍然计算成本高昂。我们提出改为使用Transformer……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出使用Transformer模型替代传统高昂的随机搜索方法，将不透明的神经人工生命智能体策略蒸馏为紧凑可解释的符号策略，从而降低计算成本，并促进智能体之间的知识共享与种群级学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using a transformer model instead of costly stochastic search to distill opaque neural A-life agent policies into compact symbolic policies, reducing computational expense while enabling knowledge sharing and population-level learning.
